units.source_text: 平日不知重复表演了多少次这个灵巧而优美的杂技，

en.t: On ordinary days, she had performed this nimble and graceful acrobatic trick countless times,

units.source_text: 如今是真的不行了，还是任性不想表演？

en.t: but now was she truly unable to do it, or was she being willful and refusing to perform?

units.source_text: 或是前些日子身体不适，加上三天招魂节受的累，

en.t: Or had the illness she had felt in recent days, together with the exhaustion from the three days of the Shokon Festival,

units.source_text: 一下子爆发出来，自己大病临头了呢？

en.t: all burst out at once, so that a serious sickness was coming over her?
Hikari herself could not understand it either.
